title: Setting any property on the "Animation" group of a TileSet closes the group
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot 4.7.1

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 15.78 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Opening the animation group / tab of the TileSet resource and setting any property of it causes the group to close.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f8bfd58c-baaa-4243-90a4-c921b156737e

### Steps to reproduce

1. Add a TileMapLayer to a scene;
2. Create the TileSet resource;
3. Add an atlas and do not let Godot create the tiles automatically (You want to create only a single tile. You can use the default Godot icon for that too);
4. Create the tile and, on the select menu, select the tile you just created;
5. Open the animation group / tab and click to add a frame;
6. You'll notice the group / tab closes and have to re-open it to set other stuff (same applies to setting a different duration for the frame).

(observation: you can probably simply create the resource directly and skip the first step)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I don't think there's the necessity of a MRP, but I just made one. The TileMapLayer is already added in the scene and the TileSet is already set up with a single tile using the Godot icon svg.

[bug-reports.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30836283/bug-reports.zip)
